Q1: Which part of the repository should this issue change?
Choices:
A) The review/autofix pipeline (`review_autofix.yml` and its `scripts/review_*` helpers)
B) The orchestrator, including the poller, judges and security pass (`orchestrate*.yml`, `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`)
C) The clarify/plan/implement phases (`clarify.yml`, `plan.yml`, `implement.yml`)
D) Documentation only (README.md, agents.md, docs/)
E) Something else: please name the file, workflow or feature in your `/answer` (RECOMMENDED)
Q2: What specific problem or goal should the change address?
Choices:
A) Fix a specific bug or failure (please give the run ID, log excerpt or behaviour you saw)
B) Reduce cost or runtime (model spend, API calls, job duration)
C) Improve reliability (fewer stalls, retries or human escalations)
D) Improve clarity or maintainability (docs or code structure), with no change in behaviour
E) Describe the concrete outcome you want in your `/answer` (RECOMMENDED)
Q3: How will we know the change worked?
Choices:
A) A named test or check passes (please name it)
B) A measurable metric improves (please give the metric and the target)
C) The behaviour described in the Q2 answer is observably fixed (RECOMMENDED)
